request.what: Cardano Constitution to Replace the Interim Constitution
deliverables: This Cardano Constitution is proposed to replace the Interim Constitution.
The Cardano Constitution is the result of extensive Cardano community consultation throughout 2024.
The Interim Constitution was intended to be temporary, and its Appendix II: Ratification of Final Constitution required its replacement to be submitted on-chain no later than January 31, 2025.
CIP-1694 The age of Voltaire for the Cardano Blockchain laid out the foundations for decentralized decision-making.
